title: Virtual Community Meetups and Showcases
summary: Elizabeth Garrett Christensen said she organizes something similar for Postgres, had been thinking about virtual meetups for Iceberg, and shared a document with her notes after talking with Kevin Liu about how to start. Scott Haines supported the proposed format of 10 minutes of community announcements, 20 to 30 minutes of technical content and 15 minutes of open discussion, the monthly cadence and the strict no-marketing guidance. Dipankar Mazumdar, who has run similar events for other Apache projects such as Hudi, said the virtual format helps global reach and offered help. Kevin Liu wants to make it happen, keep it community focused and free of marketing material, and model it on the existing guidelines for hosting an Iceberg meetup. Logistics were left for further discussion.

positions.stance: Virtual community meetups would be good for Iceberg, and her notes document is a starting point others can add to.
Supports the proposed format, the monthly cadence and the strict no-marketing guidance.
Supports the idea, noting from other Apache projects that a virtual format helps global reach, and offers to help.
Wants to make this happen, keep it community focused without marketing material, and model it on the guidelines for hosting an Iceberg meetup.

outcome.note: All replies supported monthly virtual meetups; logistics were not settled in the thread.

why_it_matters: A monthly, marketing-free virtual meetup would give contributors a place to present work regardless of location.
